title: PM Modi Remains Close Guarded On Lockdown Extension In Meeting With CMs | ABP News
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a review meeting with the Chief Ministers of various states of India. During this meeting he said that the lockdown had given positive results to India. On the other hand, PM Modi also said that the successful steps taken by India will help the nation in future as well as many foreign countries wish to invest in IndiaThe meeting has come to an end.Nothing was talked about the end of lockdown after May 3, 2020 #PMModi #LockdownExtension #MeetingWithCMs  To Subscribe our YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/user/abpnewstv    Download ABP App for Apple: https://itunes.apple.com/in/app/abp-live-abp-news-abp-ananda/id811114904?mt=8  Download ABP App for Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.winit.starnews.hin&hl=en   About Channel: ABP News is a news hub which provides you with the comprehensive up-to-date news coverage from all over India and World. asr.full_text: For every news you will get your hold. Download ABP Live app. This is big news this time. The meeting has been ended with PM Modi's meeting with the Chief Ministers of State. The meeting was going on since 10 in the morning. PM Modi has expressed his condolences to the Central government and for the efforts of the state. Approximately 3 1.5 hours the meeting went on. Approximately 3 hours... The call with the Chief Minister of State, a sit-down at 10am through video conferencing. Now that sit-down is over. So what has been the outcome? Let's go to our political reporter Pankaj Jha. Pankaj Jha, what has come out of this sit-down? What are your thoughts? The Prime Minister who was having a sit-down today told them in a series of ways that the way the lockdown has been implemented since the 25th of March, and how the situation in the country has been controlled, how the situation has improved, he said about that. Also, he also said that we are going to do something about it in some places, we will have to change our lifestyle. It is important to wear a mask, those who are constantly talking about two-dose distance, he life. We have to wear masks. They are talking for two hours. They have said that it has to be further advanced. Some states where there are many cases like Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh where the number of cases is very high the government there should not feel any extreme pressure. Apart from this, they said that the crisis that has just possible to prevent such problems. Many other country's famous and rural companies would like to come to India to help us improve our economy. The government should take initiative about this, discuss and make a policy about it. He has discussed all these things with the chief minister. Vankaj, do you also want to know, that the country is waiting for this decision. have spoken to each other You've already reported this update to the Indian government the present state of the country wants to come before the lockdown is that three days after the lockdown if the situation will continue or will it continue if it continues then what changes will be given do you have any information regarding the issue? Look, I have talked with the state ministers who are here today How can they expect how things will progress and this is about what has been discussed with the PM's and in the Q&A sessions. A detailed discussion was made of why the lockdown could continue in the future, and about what the circumstances may be, The biggest question that we're dealing with here today is that will lockdown go away or get off or will it just go a little further after March. They said that they have not given any indication to us of this yet. Mr. Ankur, I would like to hear your opinion because you said that the lock-down hasn't been set to be opened till now. However, as the Chief Minister has received feedback from the Head Minister of all the states, it is possible in that case that the cabinet takes some action. How do we then find a way to reopen this lock-down? If we have to then change the lock-down situation. What measures can the citizens of the country. Look, I have clearly clear this point Modi Sir that gradually the way the power has increased in lock down along with that how could the economy of the city has been brought on the track and you have seen that in the recent days from how the shops have opened to how some industries have become active MHA has stated this about this in some days the businesses will open up and in some businesses how the work will begin. This has been already said by the MHA. A state government like Kerala wants that work will resume. Some states are also saying that there's a hot-spot in their area and lockdown is increasing. I think Prime minister Modi will not make a decision regarding this but will see how he can extend and increase the work. It is he's very focus on the economy and her in the future. She was very focus on Earth's environment today in making a strategy. Mr Pankaj, you must have remember that during the press conference of the Prime Minister, when the Prime Minister came in front of his press conference, then by the end of June, when he declared for a general election, to some or other level it was in his mind from the same time. Yes, yes, Exactly, look at how to proceed. All the ministries are working on this and the Prime Minister's Office too is thinking about this. Thank you very much, Pankaj. To know the complete details, the biggest news for us our viewers the discussion between PM Modi and the chief state the sit-in started at 10 am on 13th May, and ended by the 10th to 10 pm. In fact, the Prime Minister himself also praised the projects carried out by the Central Government and other states. Talking about the financial situation at the sit-in, the chief ministers also raised their problems with the PM. have to be kept in the presence of the Prime Minister.
